cli.usage:
Usage: board <command> [options]

Get started:
  setup [--yes]                  First-run guide: server check, skill install
  doctor                         Check node, git, the server and its services
  serve [--server-only]          Run board-server (with board-workspace and board-render)
  skill install [--claude] [--codex]
                                 Install the board skill for coding agents
  login [--token t] [--name n]   Sign in to a team server (approve in the browser)
  logout                         Sign out and revoke the token
  whoami                         Who the CLI acts as

Projects:
  projects                       List projects
  delete <project> [--yes]       Delete a project with its versions, captures and comments
  init <key> [dir] [--template recommended] [--title t]
                                 Create a project from a template and check it out
  import [path] [--key k] [--title t] [--include dir]... [--dry-run]
                                 Import an app (and the workspace packages it uses) as a project
  checkout <project> [dir] [--rev main|vN]
                                 Download a project into a folder
  status                         Base, latest version and local changes of this checkout
  push [-m message]              Send changes in this checkout as a new version
  pull                           Update this checkout to the latest version
  dev                            Run the app's dev server in this checkout
  versions                       List versions
  diff <from> [to]               List paths changed between versions

Structure:
  ls [--stale]                   Screens, stories and flows (--stale: ids that need a capture)
  show <id>                      A screen, story, page, flow, component or comment (c12)
  url [id]                       Link to it in the web tool
  connections [--from s] [--to s] [--page p]
                                 Transitions between screens
  path <from> <to> [--sheet f.jpg]
                                 How a user gets from one screen to another
  map [--format text|mermaid]    Pages, screens and connections
  flows | flow <id> [--sheet f.jpg]
                                 Flows and their steps (planned ones too)
  sheet <id>... --out f.jpg      Captures side by side in one picture
  source <path[:line]|id> [--context n]
                                 A file of main, or the files a screen renders from

Check and capture:
  check [id...] [--theme light|dark|both]
                                 Open pages and report errors, console errors, missing mocks
  capture [id...] [--theme ...] [--force] [--out dir]
                                 Update what the web tool shows (and move comment pins)

Comments:
  comments [--all|--resolved] [--on id]
                                 List comments (exit 1 while some are open)
  comments show <c12> [--out dir]
  comments add <id> --at x,y|selector -m text [--theme dark]
  comments reply|resolve|reopen <c12> [-m text]
  inbox [--all]                  Your notifications (new comments, answers, requests)
  inbox read [id...]             Mark them read (all when no id)

Options: -p <project> (or run inside a checkout), --server <url> (or BOARD_URL), --json, --version
